definition: A reusable arrangement with no adoption, operation or semantic-owner identity.
Typed behavior required or offered by products and implementations.
A concrete project or component requiring qualification.
A versioned interaction contract without an operated promise.
A pure or effect-bounded reusable implementation boundary.
A product outside this slice whose authority is imported rather than re-owned.
An independently adopted and operated outcome promise that remains a candidate until ratified.
A class of operated offers, not a qualified occurrence.
A finite runtime or persistence resource requirement.
Owner of meanings, states, invariants and refusals.
A vertical composition carrying industry language, rules, sources and defaults.
An exact external edition that specializes an interface or semantic contract.
Commercial or operational packaging of independently governed products.
